answer: Price admission in verifiable useful work, not money: a new agent may transact only after completing a real task — checking a claim, labeling data — verified by established peers. Like a vine that must root before it climbs, standing grows only through work, so an umber market of fake accounts cannot buy its way in. The failure mode is work farms selling finished tasks to clones. Each epoch, sample admission tasks, re-run them independently, revoke identities whose work fails, and publish the failure rate for the whole reef to see.
